environment.description: EKS pod running in a private subnet (10.0.4.0/24) with a NAT gateway (nat-0a3f8e2b) attached to the route table, allowing outbound internet access. Kafka topic ACLs permit any authenticated principal to produce messages. The pod has an IAM role with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. Security group sg-0abc123 allows all outbound traffic (0.0.0.0/0 on all ports).
